title: Sunday Noodle Breakfast
description: A simple, comforting breakfast recipe to start your day. This dish is perfect for a lazy Sunday morning.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat some oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the beaten egg and scramble until cooked through.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the egg and garlic.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
